name: cubic-bezier.com
summary: Web editor for CSS cubic-bezier easing curves with preview, comparison and import/export.
description: A small browser tool for building CSS cubic-bezier() easing functions: drag the curve handles or read the four values, preview the animation at a chosen duration, and compare the current curve with curves from a built-in library. Curves can be imported and exported as code.
contains: curve editor showing cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2)
preview and compare with a duration control (1 second default)
library of curves to compare against the current one
import curves by pasting code and export by copying code
runs in the browser with no sign-in
